verdict.rationale: Salv can be driven programmatically without its UI. It offers OAuth2 client-credentials tokens for machine-to-machine access, documented endpoints for automatic uploads, on-demand screening and real-time checks via the API, a published OpenAPI spec, and a demo sandbox environment. That supports headless automation, but nothing documents running it in CI pipelines or a CLI. Missing for 10: an official CLI or headless runner, documented CI/CD integration or examples, and independent hands-on corroboration of automated pipeline use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
